Name: (CR) Kisaa's Cozy Rustic Cellar
Author: crystalinerose
Description:
[center][size=4][b](v.1.1.0 UPDATE ANNOUNCEMENT: [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]Misc Map Actions Properties[/url] is now a hard dependency. Please download the latest version [i]and [/i]perform a clean install of this mod.)
[b]-[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Cozy Rustic Cellar [/b]is a lofted cellar redesign with a compact, optionally expandable layout in a "modern rustic" theme and native recolor support for some popular recolors. [/size]
[size=4][b]-[/b][/size]

[b][size=3]🌿 This mod is a part of the Cozy Rustic Interior Suite! 🌿[/size][/b]
[b][size=3]Find the rest of the series: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30714]Kitchen [/url]| [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30038]Farmhouse [/url]| [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30070]Cellar [/url]| [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30170]Greenhouse [/url]| [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46144]Shed[/url][/size][/b]

[b][size=3]🌿 Need matching Cozy Rustic Furniture? 🌿[/size][/b]
[b][size=3]Find them here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33316]Buildable Kitchen[/url] | [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33318]Bakery n' Cafe[/url][/size][/b]
[size=4][b]-[/b][/size]﻿﻿[/center]
[img]http://i.ibb.co.com/tYhckBZ/features.png[/img]

[list]
[*]﻿[b]Native Recolor Support: [/b]Has recolor options to match [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/url]﻿[/b], [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14790]DaisyNiko's Earthy Interiors[/url]﻿[/b], [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21085]Starblue Valley[/url]﻿[/b], and the Oak Saloon swatch from [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/1184314-asters-beam-and-kitchen-mod-for-farm-building-interiors/comments]Aster's Beam Mod[/url]﻿.[/*]
[*][b]Customizable size: [/b]Choose between a standard and expanded size with the [b]Extra Room [/b]config option.[/*]
[*][b]Decorating space: [/b]The cellar has an additional nook for decorating or for machine space if you need it![/*]
[/list]
[i][img]https://i.ibb.co.com/Lx0ybss/config-options.png[/img][/i]

[list]
[*][b]Enable Mod: [/b]Enables/disables all patches added by this mod, including loading the cellar itself.[/*]
[*][b]Cellar Recolor: [/b]Changes custom tilesheet color to match your interior recolor mod.[/*]
[*][b]Extra Room: [/b]Adds an extra space in the cellar reachable via door on the lower area.[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/3NC8PLn/compatibility.png[/img]

[b][u]Compatible[/u] [/b]with the following mods that affect interior recolors: [b]VPR, Earthy Interiors, Starblue, Rustic Country Town Interior (Dark, Light)[/b].
[b][u]Compatible[/u][/b] with custom farmhouses as the map has the same warp points as the Vanilla cellar map.
[b][u]
Partially Compatible[/u][/b] with [b]Aster's Beam Mod[/b] for the following swatch: [b]OakSaloon. [/b]This matches the Vanilla 'Dark Oak' used in cellars and certain town interiors.

[b][u]Not Compatible[/u] [/b]with any mod that edits Maps/Cellar or Cellar.tmx.

[b]I will not add recolor compatibility with mods other than the ones mentioned in the above section.[/b] If you want to add an unsupported recolor, contact me first. Uploading a recolor compatibility to this mod as a separate mod on Nexus or any other platform is strictly prohibited.

﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/0sYpYjq/installation.png[/img]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.[/*]
[*]Install [b]Noclip Mode [/b](not required, but recommended for dealing with bugs).[/*]
[*]Download and unzip [i]"(CR) Kisaa's Cozy Rustic Cellar" [/i]archive into your SteamLibrary/common/Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]﻿Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Have fun![/*]
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/JRHCTRD/bugs-issues.png[/img]

[list]
[*][b]IMPORTANT - Before changing to a new cellar mod or deleting this mod (NOT toggling on/off via config), remove all placed items and decor because they can disappear.[/b][/*]
[*]The starting position of casks obtained from the 3rd farmhouse upgrade is hardcoded and will end up in inaccessible positions. Use [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]Noclip Mode[/url]﻿[/b] to pick your casks up.[/*]
[*]The tiles with the loft railing fence on the right side of the cellar are impassable. This is required to prevent players from clipping between the cellar levels; as a consequence, you cannot place furniture on these tiles, unless you use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21233]Anything Anywhere[/url]﻿.[/*]
[*]You cannot change walls, flooring, nor place furniture on walls; this is a hardcoded limitation. To be able to place wall decor like in the previews, use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21233]Anything Anywhere[/url]﻿.[/*]
[*][s]When using the expanded cellar layout, the door warp would lead farmhands to the host's cellar in multiplayer. Farmhouse Fixes﻿ might be able to mitigate this, but I can't guarantee I will be able to do anything about it.[/s] Should be fixed by MMAP. Farmhouse Fixes is no longer required in any capacity.[/*]
[*]Not yet properly tested on multiplayer. Feel free to and report any multiplayer-related issues back to me, but I cannot guarantee I can fix them.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Please prioritize reporting any bugs on the Nexus page and follow the directions listed in the pinned comment.[/b]

[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/VVn4qL0/credits.png[/img]

A special thank you to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Sharogg?gameId=1303]Sharogg[/url]﻿, [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/ClairesStoryofSeasons]Claire[/url], and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Teaiscoldagain?gameId=1303]Lina [/url]for all the support during the making of the Cozy Rustic series!

Thank you to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/vikich3rry]vikich3rry[/url] for helping me with the RCTI Dark base, which allowed me to push the new RCTI compatibility patch even sooner than planned!

Downloads.Description:
DO A CLEAN INSTALL OF THIS MOD.

- Updated tilesheet assets.
- Changed built-in lighting system to fully use MMAP's Light and LightCond actions.
- Warp to extra room now uses MMAP WrpHere, so hopefully it fixes the wrong multiplayer warps (thanks Aba!)
